name: synthetic-fetch-header-absent
description: SYNTHETIC. Same 200 body as fetch-example.json (a real 2026-10-24 recording), but with no x-billed-request-type response header at all — proves a transport that does not surface the header settles zero usage rather than guessing which billed type applies. String always sends the header on a billed response, so this case cannot be recorded.
